title: Design System: Vietnam Japan Capital Atlas

display.purpose: Major section analysis headings and report titles. Heaviest text the interface produces.

headline.purpose: Prominent metric numbers in chart cards, investor drawer titles.

title.purpose: Chart card headings, navigation labels, signal row headings. The workhorse heading level.

body.purpose: All running analysis prose. Max line-length 54-65ch enforced via container max-width.

label.purpose: Section markers and category identifiers only. Uppercase with 0.12em letter-spacing. The only tracking in the system.

caption.purpose: Chart sub-descriptions, investor metadata, coordinate and confidence labels.

shadows.name: ambient-lift
shadows.purpose: Language dropdown panel and other overlaid surfaces. Barely perceptible separation from the page at rest.

shadows.name: hover-pull
shadows.purpose: Standard interactive lift for hovered/focused clickable surfaces: buttons, cluster markers.

shadows.name: drawer-dominance
shadows.purpose: Company drawer left-edge shadow only. Scale signals this is the dominant surface while open.

shadows.name: company-icon
shadows.purpose: Floating company logo badge inside company visual figures.

shadows.name: marker-drop
shadows.purpose: Map investor pin drop shadow. Combined with concentric color-tinted ring shadows on hover.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all micro-interactions: button color, border-color, background, opacity transitions.

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.purpose: Ease-out-expo for drawer open, dropdown reveal, and other surface entrance animations.

motion.name: ease-marker
motion.purpose: Map pin hover scale and shadow transitions.

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.purpose: Topbar stacks vertically; select control spans full width.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Investor directory rows expand to 5-column layout.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Analysis grid becomes 2-column; map header gains sidebar column.

breakpoints.name: map-sm
breakpoints.purpose: Mobile map: map stage height reduces, fallback pins truncate, timeline stacks vertically.

breakpoints.name: nav
breakpoints.purpose: Primary nav tab row hides; page-select dropdown replaces it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action. Mekong Teal fill, Paper Warm text. View on Map, Report Source.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.35rem; padding: 0.58rem 0.78rem; background: oklch(47% 0.11 162); color: oklch(97.7% 0.009 98); border: 1px solid oklch(47% 0.11 162); border-radius: 0.48rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: oklch(41% 0.105 162); border-color: oklch(41% 0.105 162); transform: translateY(-1px); outline: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary working-surface control. Paper Warm fill at rest; Surface Tonal + Mekong Teal border on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.35rem; padding: 0.58rem 0.78rem; background: oklch(97.7% 0.009 98); color: oklch(22% 0.018 176); border: 1px solid oklch(82% 0.022 154); border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { background: oklch(91.4% 0.041 154); border-color: oklch(55% 0.11 162); color: oklch(24% 0.045 162); transform: translateY(-1px); outline: none; }

components.name: Filter Button
components.description: Sector filter pill used above the investor map. Identical to secondary at rest; is-active mirrors hover state without lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.35rem; padding: 0.58rem 0.78rem; background: oklch(97.7% 0.009 98); color: oklch(22% 0.018 176); border: 1px solid oklch(82% 0.022 154); border-radius: 0.48rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-filter:hover, .ds-btn-filter:focus-visible, .ds-btn-filter--active { background: oklch(91.4% 0.041 154); border-color: oklch(55% 0.11 162); color: oklch(24% 0.045 162); outline: none; }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: Primary page tab. Transparent at rest. Active state: Surface Tonal fill, Mekong Teal border, dark green text.
components.css: .ds-primary-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.48rem 0.72rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(35% 0.023 176); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.45rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 850; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-tab:hover, .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { background: oklch(94.8% 0.013 120); border-color: oklch(82% 0.022 154); color: oklch(22% 0.018 176); outline: none; } .ds-nav-tab--active { background: oklch(90.5% 0.04 156); border-color: oklch(67% 0.09 162); color: oklch(27% 0.058 162); }

components.name: Investor Map Marker
components.description: Signature teardrop map pin. Rotated square with asymmetric radius creates the teardrop. Initials counter-rotate to stay upright.
components.css: .ds-investor-marker { --marker-color: oklch(47% 0.11 162); position: relative; width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid oklch(97.5% 0.01 108); border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 7px; appearance: none; display: grid; place-items: center; color: oklch(97.5% 0.01 108); background: var(--marker-color); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px oklch(22% 0.018 176 / 0.2), 0 0 0 7px color-mix(in oklch, var(--marker-color) 18%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transform: rotate(-45deg); transition: box-shadow 180ms ease-out, filter 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-investor-marker::before { content: attr(data-label); width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: oklch(97.5% 0.01 108 / 0.18); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 950; transform: rotate(45deg); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-investor-marker:hover, .ds-investor-marker:focus-visible { z-index: 10; filter: saturate(1.14); outline: none; transform: rotate(-45deg) scale(1.16); box-shadow: 0 16px 36px oklch(22% 0.018 176 / 0.26), 0 0 0 11px color-mix(in oklch, var(--marker-color) 20%, transparent), 0 0 24px color-mix(in oklch, var(--marker-color) 42%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Sector category label in the investor directory. Color-mixed background adapts to any --chip-color accent.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { --chip-color: oklch(47% 0.11 162); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--chip-color) 12%, oklch(97.7% 0.009 98)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--chip-color) 28%, oklch(78% 0.02 150)); border-radius: 0.45rem; color: oklch(24% 0.035 176); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; min-height: 1.8rem; padding: 0.42rem 0.56rem; } .ds-status-chip--urban { --chip-color: oklch(54% 0.12 235); }

narrative.overview:
A senior analyst's command surface: every element positioned with purpose, density calibrated to expertise, confidence expressed through precision not decoration. The palette reads like a document printed on good paper, the typography carries institutional weight through weight contrast alone, and the single accent earns its authority by appearing rarely. When this tool is open on a screen at the front of a meeting room, the room should read it as credible before anyone speaks.

The system is warm without being soft. The paper tone leans amber, the neutrals carry a persistent green tint toward hue 154-176, the borders share that tint. Nothing is the default gray of a system that forgot to think about color. Depth is expressed through a tonal stack (Paper Warm, Surface Mid, Surface Tonal) reinforced by 1px green-tinted borders. Shadows are earned by interaction, not assigned to status.

This system explicitly rejects the government data portal aesthetic (austere, under-designed, spiritually resigned) and startup pitch deck energy (oversized metric heroes, bar charts that animate on scroll for spectacle, Series A framing). The Dispatch Table is an intelligence product used by people who already know the thesis and need evidence to travel credibly across three languages and two national investment cultures.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral light mode base (Paper Warm to Surface Mid to Surface Tonal hierarchy)
Single structural accent (Mekong Teal) on under 15% of any screen at any time
Weight contrast (950 vs 400) as the primary typographic hierarchy signal, not just size
State-reactive elevation: zero resting shadow, lifted on hover and interaction
Six-series data color vocabulary reserved strictly for encoding, never decoration
All text and data must read at presentation distance (2 meters from a projector)
OKLCH-only color doctrine throughout the codebase

rules.name: The Mekong Rule
rules.body: Mekong Teal appears on under 15% of any screen. Its rarity is its authority. If teal covers more than 15% of the viewport at once, it has become a theme, not an accent, and the system loses its restraint.

rules.name: The Six-Series Rule
rules.body: The data palette (Jade Wave, Data Gold, Data Coral, Data Sky, Data Violet, plus Mekong Teal as series one) is reserved for encoding data series on charts and map markers. Never apply a data color to a UI state, status badge, or decorative element.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: Every neutral in the system carries a nonzero chroma toward hue 150-176. No new neutral may be added at chroma 0. That is a pure gray and it does not belong in this palette.

rules.name: The Weight Stack Rule
rules.body: No heading level may increase in size without also increasing in weight, and no weight increase is meaningful without a size shift. Hierarchy is always both dimensions together.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The eyebrow pattern (uppercase, weight 900, 0.12em letter-spacing, 0.72rem) is the only typographic context in the entire system that uses letter-spacing. Do not add tracking to any other text element.

rules.name: The Line Length Rule
rules.body: Body text containers are capped at 54-65ch. No body paragraph runs wall-to-wall at wide viewport widths.

rules.name: The Flat-First Rule
rules.body: Shadows are earned by state change, not assigned to hierarchy. Every interactive component starts at zero box-shadow. Shadows appear only on hover, focus-visible, or open/active states.

dos: Do use OKLCH for every color value in the codebase. No hex, HSL, or RGB literals for new tokens.
Do keep Mekong Teal under 15% surface coverage at any viewport state.
Do encode data series using the six-series vocabulary in order: Mekong Teal, Jade Wave, Data Gold, Data Coral, Data Sky, Data Violet. Never invent a new data color.
Do apply Thread Line borders (oklch(82% 0.022 154)) on all container borders. Never use a gray or neutral border.
Do make shadows reactive. Start every component at zero box-shadow. Elevate only on hover, focus-visible, or active/open states.
Do use ease-out curves for all transitions: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for entrances, ease-out for micro-interactions.
Do reserve the eyebrow label pattern for section markers and category identifiers only. It is the only tracking in the system.
Do test all critical data labels at presentation distance. Chart legends, map legends, and region labels must read at 2 meters.
Do maintain the tonal stack when adding new surfaces: containers inside Paper Warm use Surface Mid; containers inside Surface Mid use Surface Tonal or Paper Warm.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right wider than 1px as a colored accent stripe on any card, callout, list item, or alert. Use full border or background tint instead.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient. All emphasis is weight and size. Gradient text has no role here.
Don't apply the government data portal aesthetic: default-gray surfaces, unstyled system font, flat tables with no visual hierarchy.
Don't use startup pitch energy: a hero section leading with a big number, small supporting label, and gradient accent (the hero-metric anti-pattern).
Don't use glassmorphism. No backdrop-filter: blur() as decoration on any card, panel, or overlay.
Don't add shadows to resting surfaces. Chart cards, signal rows, and nav tabs have zero box-shadow at rest.
Don't use #000000 or #ffffff. Night Ground (oklch(18% 0.02 176)) and Paper Warm (oklch(97.7% 0.009 98)) are the system extremes.
Don't nest two bordered containers with the same border style inside each other.
Don't use the data palette colors (Data Gold, Data Coral, Data Sky, Data Violet, Jade Wave) as UI state colors or decorative accents.
